# ApplyItineraryCommand

## Summary

Writes a planned itinerary onto a Travel Itinerary card. Input is an `ApplyItineraryInput` card carrying `cardId` (the trip to update) and `planJson` (the itinerary as the same JSON the travel-planner skill produces: `{ tripTitle, summary, stops: [{ day, name, lat, lon, startTime, endTime, notes, category }] }`), plus optional `destination`, `startDate`, and `endDate`. Only `cardId` and `planJson` are required.

The command parses the plan, refines every stop's coordinates through Photon (`geocodePlannedStops` — the LLM's coordinates are treated as a hint, not an answer), coerces each `category` to the enum via `matchCategory`, then patches the card through `PatchCardInstanceCommand`. Stops are replaced wholesale; `tripTitle` is set when the plan carries one; `dateRange` is set only when both dates are valid `YYYY-MM-DD`, so a revision that omits them leaves the card's dates alone; `destination` is geocoded so the map recenters.

The travel-planner skill exposes this to the AI Assistant as a tool, so the assistant plans conversationally and calls this once the traveller approves.

## Import

```js
import ApplyItineraryCommand from '../commands/apply-itinerary-command';
```

## Usage

```js
let ctx = this.args.context?.commandContext;
await new ApplyItineraryCommand(ctx).execute({
  cardId: this.args.model.id,
  planJson: JSON.stringify({ tripTitle, summary, stops }),
  destination: 'Tokyo, Japan',
  startDate: '2026-04-02',
  endDate: '2026-04-09',
});
```
